theorem gcd_quotient_split_injective (m : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (fun e : ℕ => (Nat.gcd e m, e / Nat.gcd e m)) := by
  intro e f h
  calc
    e = Nat.gcd e m * (e / Nat.gcd e m) :=
      (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_left e m)).symm
    _ = Nat.gcd f m * (f / Nat.gcd f m) :=
      congrArg (fun z : ℕ × ℕ => z.1 * z.2) h
    _ = f := Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_left f m)

theorem fouvryTau_mul_argument_le {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) :
    ∀ {m n : ℕ}, 0 < m → 0 < n →
      fouvryTau j (m * n) ≤ fouvryTau j m * fouvryTau j n := by

theorem fouvryTau_succ (k n : ℕ) :
    fouvryTau (k + 1) n = ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, fouvryTau k d := by
  exact ArithmeticFunction.coe_mul_zeta_apply (f := fouvryTau k)

theorem sum_fouvryTau_div_le_real (k : ℕ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) :
    (∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊, (fouvryTau k n : ℝ) / n) ≤ (1 + Real.log x) ^ k := by
  have heq : reciprocalSum ⌊x⌋₊ = (harmonic ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) := by

theorem gcd_dvd_left (m n : Nat) : gcd m n ∣ m := (gcd_dvd m n).left

theorem gcd_dvd_right (m n : Nat) : gcd m n ∣ n := (gcd_dvd m n).right

theorem gcd_pos_of_pos_left {m : Nat} (n : Nat) (mpos : 0 < m) : 0 < gcd m n :=
  pos_of_dvd_of_pos (gcd_dvd_left m n) mpos

theorem gcd_pos_of_pos_right (m : Nat) {n : Nat} (npos : 0 < n) : 0 < gcd m n :=
  pos_of_dvd_of_pos (gcd_dvd_right m n) npos

theorem div_gcd_pos_of_pos_left (b : Nat) (h : 0 < a) : 0 < a / a.gcd b :=
  (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le <| Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ h).2 (Nat.one_mul _ ▸ Nat.gcd_le_left _ h)

protected theorem mul_div_cancel' {n m : Nat} (H : n ∣ m) : n * (m / n) = m := by
  have := mod_add_div m n
  rwa [mod_eq_zero_of_dvd H, Nat.zero_add] at this

protected theorem mul_div_assoc (m : Nat) (H : k ∣ n) : m * n / k = m * (n / k) := by
  match Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with
  | .inl h0 => rw [h0, Nat.div_zero, Nat.div_zero, Nat.mul_zero]
  | .inr hpos =>

theorem div_le_self (n k : Nat) : n / k ≤ n := by
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | ind n ih =>
theorem lcm_eq_mul_div (m n : Nat) : lcm m n = m * n / gcd m n := rfl

theorem lcm_pos : 0 < m → 0 < n → 0 < lcm m n := by
  simpa [← Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero] using lcm_ne_zero

theorem mem_divisors {m : ℕ} : n ∈ divisors m ↔ n ∣ m ∧ m ≠ 0 := by
  rcases eq_or_ne m 0 with (rfl | hm); · simp [divisors]
  simp only [hm, Ne, not_false_iff, and_true, ← filter_dvd_eq_divisors hm, mem_filter,

@[to_additive]
theorem div_mul_div_comm : a / b * (c / d) = a * c / (b * d) := by simp

lemma Finset.sum_div (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → K) (a : K) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) / a = ∑ i ∈ s, f i / a := by simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, sum_mul]

lemma sum_mul_sum (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (f : ι → R) (g : κ → R) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) * ∑ j ∈ t, g j = ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ t, f i * g j := by
  simp_rw [sum_mul, ← mul_sum]

map_multiset_prod (castRingHom R) _

@[simp, norm_cast]
lemma cast_sum [AddCommMonoidWithOne R] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℕ) :
    ↑(∑ x ∈ s, f x : ℕ) = ∑ x ∈ s, (f x : R) :=
  map_sum (castAddMonoidHom R) _ _

/-- If a function is injective on a finset, products over the original finset or its image coincide.
See also `prod_image_of_pairwise_eq_one` for a version with weaker assumptions. -/
@[to_additive (attr := simp) /-- If a function is injective on a finset, sums over the original
finset or its image coincide.
See also `sum_image_of_pairwise_eq_zero` for a version with weaker assumptions. -/]
theorem prod_image [DecidableEq ι] {s : Finset κ} {g : κ → ι} :
    Set.InjOn g s → ∏ x ∈ s.image g, f x = ∏ x ∈ s, f (g x) :=
  fold_image

@[to_additive (attr := gcongr) sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg]
theorem prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le' [MulLeftMono N] (h : s ⊆ t)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ t, i ∉ s → 1 ≤ f i) : ∏ i ∈ s, f i ≤ ∏ i ∈ t, f i := by
  classical calc
      ∏ i ∈ s, f i ≤ (∏ i ∈ t \ s, f i) * ∏ i ∈ s, f i :=
        le_mul_of_one_le_left' <| one_le_prod' <| by simpa only [mem_sdiff, and_imp]
      _ = ∏ i ∈ t \ s ∪ s, f i := (prod_union sdiff_disjoint).symm
      _ = ∏ i ∈ t, f i := by rw [sdiff_union_of_subset h]

@[mono, gcongr, bound]
lemma div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hab : a ≤ b) (hc : 0 ≤ c) : a / c ≤ b / c := by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv a c, div_eq_mul_inv b c]
  gcongr; exact Right.inv_nonneg.2 hc

exact_target: For every j,D,q:Nat with1<=j and0<q, sum_(d in Icc1D)(d_j(d):Real)/(lcm(d,q):Real)<=((d_(j+1)(q):Real)/(q:Real))*sum_(u in Icc1D)(d_j(u):Real)/(u:Real). D=0 is allowed. No real endpoint Z occurs.
complete_source_argument: Set splitDivisor(d)=(gcd(d,q),d/gcd(d,q)) and W(g,u)=(d_j(g)/q)*(d_j(u)/u). Reuse exactly the source-reviewed parent gcd_quotient_split_injective q; no new fiber injection or CRT claim is introduced.

For d in Icc1D, d>=1 supplies positive g and u by actual core Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left and Nat.div_gcd_pos_of_pos_left. g divides q; since q>0 this places g in the complete q.divisors. The actual Nat.div_le_self gives u<=d<=D, placing u in Icc1D.
Nat.lcm_eq_mul_div, commutativity and actual Nat.mul_div_assoc with gcd(d,q)|d give the exact identity lcm(d,q)=q*(d/gcd(d,q)), valid also when d=0. No false assertion gcd(u,q)=1 is used.

Apply the new parent argument submultiplicativity at the two positive split factors and rewrite g*u=d by Nat.mul_div_cancel. exact_mod_cast gives the real numerator inequality. Actual Nat.lcm_pos and casting prove the denominator strictly positive.

Divide the numerator inequality by the unchanged nonnegative lcm denominator. Rewrite lcm=q*u, cast the natural product, then apply actual div_mul_div_comm to identify the comparison summand with W(splitDivisor d). No denominator or divisor factor is dropped.

Sum the pointwise inequalities. Finset.sum_image with the global parent injection gives equality with the weighted image sum. Enlarge that image to q.divisors×Icc1D using nonnegative W. W>=0 follows from casts and div_nonneg even outside the positive carrier.

Finset.sum_product and actual Finset.sum_mul_sum factor the complete product sum. Pull the fixed1/q through its divisor sum by reverse Finset.sum_div, then reverse Nat.cast_sum and native fouvryTau_succ j q. This gives exactly d_(j+1)(q)/q times the original finite harmonic sum, with constant1.
All statements about d in Icc1D are vacuous when D=0. Both sides are empty sums (right multiplied by the finite coefficient) and equal0; the same proof needs no D>0 branch or real Z assumption.
